raw_text:
# 12-Week Strength & Hypertrophy Programme

**Client:** 26F, recreational lifter, on combined OCP (asymptomatic, no cycle-based phasing required), cleared for full intensity.
**Start date:** 2026-06-01 (Monday)
**End date:** 2026-08-23
**Goal:** Strength + body composition
**Structure:** 4 sessions/week, Upper/Lower split with a dedicated posterior chain and a dedicated push/quad emphasis day.
**Weekly template:** Mon — Lower (squat focus), Tue — Upper (push focus), Thu — Lower (hinge focus), Fri — Upper (pull focus).

---

## Phase 1 — Foundation & Hypertrophy (Weeks 1–4)
**Dates:** 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-28
**Focus:** Movement quality, work capacity, hypertrophy base. Moderate loads, RPE 6–8, 2–3 reps in reserve. Tempo emphasis on eccentrics (3s down on main lifts).

### Week 1 (1 Jun – 7 Jun) — Introductory load (~70% of working weight)

**Mon — Lower (Squat focus)**
- Back squat — 3 × 8, RPE 6
- Romanian deadlift — 3 × 10
- Walking lunge — 3 × 10/leg
- Leg extension — 2 × 12
- Standing calf raise — 3 × 12
- Hanging knee raise — 3 × 10

**Tue — Upper (Push focus)**
- Bench press — 3 × 8, RPE 6
- Standing DB shoulder press — 3 × 10
- Incline DB press — 2 × 10
- Cable triceps pushdown — 3 × 12
- Lateral raise — 3 × 12
- Plank — 3 × 30s

**Thu — Lower (Hinge focus)**
- Conventional deadlift — 3 × 6, RPE 6
- Front squat or goblet squat — 3 × 8
- Hip thrust — 3 × 10
- Seated leg curl — 3 × 12
- Seated calf raise — 3 × 15
- Pallof press — 3 × 10/side

**Fri — Upper (Pull focus)**
- Chest-supported row — 3 × 10
- Lat pulldown — 3 × 10
- DB bench press — 3 × 10
- Face pull — 3 × 15
- Hammer curl — 3 × 12
- Cable woodchop — 3 × 10/side

### Week 2 (8 Jun – 14 Jun)
Same template; add ~2.5 kg to main lifts, push accessories to RPE 7. Add 1 set to one accessory per session.

### Week 3 (15 Jun – 21 Jun)
Same template; another small load increase. Main lifts move to 3 × 8 @ RPE 7–8. Accessories trending to top of rep range.

### Week 4 (22 Jun – 28 Jun) — Deload
All main lifts: 2 × 6 @ ~60% of Week 3 load. Accessories: 2 sets, light, focus on tempo and contraction. No grinding reps. Optional extra mobility/walking on Wed/Sat.

---

## Phase 2 — Strength Accumulation (Weeks 5–8)
**Dates:** 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-26
**Focus:** Lower reps on primaries, heavier loads (RPE 7–9). Hypertrophy maintained via accessories. Introduce paused variations.

### Week 5 (29 Jun – 5 Jul)

**Mon — Lower (Squat focus)**
- Back squat — 4 × 5, RPE 7
- Pause squat (2s) — 2 × 5
- Bulgarian split squat — 3 × 8/leg
- Leg press — 3 × 10
- Standing calf raise — 4 × 10
- Cable crunch — 3 × 12

**Tue — Upper (Push focus)**
- Bench press — 4 × 5, RPE 7
- Close-grip bench — 3 × 8
- Seated DB shoulder press — 3 × 8
- Lateral raise — 3 × 15
- Overhead triceps extension — 3 × 10
- Side plank — 3 × 30s/side

**Thu — Lower (Hinge focus)**
- Deadlift — 4 × 4, RPE 7
- Deficit RDL — 3 × 8
- Hip thrust — 4 × 8
- Lying leg curl — 3 × 12
- Seated calf raise — 3 × 15
- Hanging leg raise — 3 × 8

**Fri — Upper (Pull focus)**
- Weighted pull-up or assisted — 4 × 6
- Barbell row — 4 × 6, RPE 7
- Incline DB press — 3 × 8
- Cable row — 3 × 10
- Incline DB curl — 3 × 10
- Face pull — 3 × 15

### Week 6 (6 Jul – 12 Jul)
Add load to main lifts (~2.5 kg upper, 5 kg lower). Same set/rep scheme, RPE 7–8.

### Week 7 (13 Jul – 19 Jul) — Peak intensity for this phase
Back squat, bench, deadlift, row top set + back-offs: 1 × 3 @ RPE 8, then 3 × 5 @ ~85% of top set. Accessories unchanged.

### Week 8 (20 Jul – 26 Jul) — Deload
Main lifts: 2 × 3 @ 65–70%. Accessories cut in half. Add a light Zone 2 cardio session (30 min) midweek.

---

## Phase 3 — Strength Expression & Physique Refinement (Weeks 9–12)
**Dates:** 2026-07-27 to 2026-08-23
**Focus:** Test strength on primaries while pushing hypertrophy volume on accessories for body comp. RPE 8–9 on top sets.

### Week 9 (27 Jul – 2 Aug)

**Mon — Lower (Squat focus)**
- Back squat — work up to 1 × 3 @ RPE 8, then 3 × 5 @ 85%
- Front squat — 3 × 6
- Walking lunge — 3 × 10/leg
- Leg extension — 3 × 15 (drop set on last)
- Calf raise — 4 × 12

**Tue — Upper (Push focus)**
- Bench press — work up to 1 × 3 @ RPE 8, then 3 × 5 @ 85%
- Overhead press — 4 × 6
- Incline DB press — 3 × 10
- Cable lateral raise — 4 × 15
- Triceps pushdown + overhead extension superset — 3 × 12 each

**Thu — Lower (Hinge focus)**
- Deadlift — work up to 1 × 2 @ RPE 8, then 2 × 4 @ 85%
- Hip thrust — 4 × 6
- Single-leg RDL — 3 × 8/leg
- Seated leg curl — 4 × 12
- Ab wheel — 3 × 8

**Fri — Upper (Pull focus)**
- Weighted pull-up — 4 × 5
- Pendlay row — 4 × 5
- DB bench — 3 × 10
- Cable row — 3 × 12
- Hammer curl + cable curl superset — 3 × 10 each
- Face pull — 3 × 20

### Week 10 (3 Aug – 9 Aug)
Same structure, +2.5 kg main lifts. Add a 4th set to one accessory per session.

### Week 11 (10 Aug – 16 Aug) — Peak week
- Squat — 1 × 2 @ RPE 9
- Bench — 1 × 2 @ RPE 9
- Deadlift — 1 × 1 @ RPE 9
- Row — 1 × 3 @ RPE 9
Back-off: 2 × 5 @ 80%. Accessories at maintenance volume (cut 1 set each) to allow recovery.

### Week 12 (17 Aug – 23 Aug) — Test week + transition
- **Mon:** Squat 1RM test (work up in singles)
- **Tue:** Bench 1RM test
- **Thu:** Deadlift 1RM test
- **Fri:** Light pull session (3 × 8 across the board) + measurements, photos, body comp reassessment

---

## Nutrition (general guidance — adjust to goal)
- **Protein:** 1.8–2.2 g/kg bodyweight daily, distributed over 4 meals.
- **Body comp focus:** Slight caloric deficit (~300–400 kcal) through Phase 1 and 2 if fat loss is the goal; move to maintenance in Phase 3 to support strength testing. If recomposition is the goal, hold maintenance throughout.
- **Carbs:** Bias around training (pre- and post-session).
- **Hydration:** 30–35 ml/kg/day baseline, more on training days.
- **Creatine monohydrate:** 5 g/day, taken consistently.
- **OCP note:** Combined OCP can modestly blunt strength/hypertrophy adaptations vs. natural cycles in some studies, but effect size is small and inconsistent — programming-wise, no adjustment needed. Just ensure protein intake is at the higher end (≥1.8 g/kg) and recovery markers are well-managed.

## Recovery
- **Sleep:** 7.5–9 h/night, consistent schedule.
- **Active recovery:** 1–2 × 30–45 min Zone 2 walking or cycling on off days (Wed, Sat, Sun).
- **Mobility:** 10 min daily — hip, ankle, T-spine focus.
- **Deloads:** Built into Weeks 4 and 8 as outlined.
- **Stress/HRV check-ins:** Weekly subjective rating (sleep, soreness, mood, energy 1–5) before Monday session. If two consecutive weeks of declining trend, pull RPE back by 1 across the board.

## Tracking
- Log every working set (load, reps, RPE).
- Bodyweight: 3× weekly, averaged.
- Photos + circumference measurements: Week 1, Week 4, Week 8, Week 12.
- Strength benchmark: Tested in Week 12 vs. estimated baselines from Week 1.

Let me know her current estimated 1RMs (or recent training maxes) and I'll plug specific kg loads into each session.
